projects.scheduleText: Once scheduled, it runs on its own, even when your computer is off. You find each new result under Scheduled in Claude's sidebar, and you can pause or change it there at any time.
projects.schedulePlan: Scheduling needs a paid Claude plan (Pro or above).
home.eyebrow: No GitHub · No code · Just Claude
home.how1: Each project comes as a small .zip file: the instructions Claude follows to do the job well.
home.how2: Upload it once under Customize, Skills. It works in the Claude app on your computer, phone or browser.
home.how3: Ask for the first result, then let Claude schedule it. Scheduled projects keep arriving with no effort.
home.leadText: I build things with Claude and share them here so anyone can use them, not just people who code. Download one file, add it to Claude, done.
why.title: Why this exists
why.statementHtml: Good AI work shouldn't stay with the people who can code.
why.text: Most AI projects are shared on GitHub. To use one, you clone a repository, install tools, set up keys and type commands in a terminal. That shuts most people out. Here, every project is a single file you add to Claude. If you can attach a photo to an email, you can use these.
why.note: You need a Claude account. Daily or monthly scheduling needs a paid plan.
projects.downloadHow: In Claude, add the .zip under Customize, Skills.
